claim: A snapshot taken in a BASIC loader shows only an inert source copy of the engine; pre-run the recording to the first frame where the engine is live, stopping before hardware detection.

evidence.text: PC in ROM (BASIC PAUSE 0 before RANDOMIZE USR), the engine found only as an inert copy; fix: pre-run the recording to the first frame boundary where the engine is identified and live, finish any LDIR, and take that state before hardware detection (Kempston).
